quotes.author: ipeichung
quotes.text: Super friendly and flexible owner. We had a great experience. Thank you so much! For people who are first time in the area, I will recommend plan extra time to find the place and download ParkMobile if new to the area to save time parking. The meet up place is about 2-5 mins walk after parking. But definitely use phone GPS so don’t get lost. Gps is the best way to find the direction to walk to the marina after parking.ipeichungTripAdvisor
